verdict.rationale: A public GitHub repository at speakeasy-api/gram carries the product's README feature descriptions, which suggests the source is readable on GitHub. However, nothing in the pack states which license applies or whether it is an OSI-approved open license. Missing for 10: an explicitly evidenced open-source license, confirmation that the full product source (not just client/CLI pieces) is in the repo, and independent corroboration of self-hostable or open code.
